answer: Sybil resistance follows from combining EigenTrust-style eigenvector centrality with reciprocity-weighted transitivity and exponential temporal decay: reputation loses half its weight each fixed interval, so trust requires sustained honest service across the scoring horizon. A freshly spawned identity has near-zero centrality because it lacks trusted paths and reciprocal evidence; a small delta in its activity cannot manufacture credible trust, even if it imitates timber-like bursts of traffic, and it cannot pass consensus.
